title: tls_codec 0.5.0 DeserializeBytes panics debug builds on truncated input
description: Reproduced: VLBytes::tls_deserialize_bytes(&[0x05,0xaa,0xbb]) hits debug_assert_eq! in quic_vec.rs:370 (also :469) and panics (exit 101) in debug builds; release returns DecodingError. Any untrusted input decoded via DeserializeBytes is a debug-build DoS. Rule for mimid: decode untrusted input only via the Read-based Deserialize path (tls_deserialize_exact). To do: (1) check whether openmls 0.9.1 decodes MlsMessageIn/KeyPackage/Welcome/GroupInfo via DeserializeBytes, and if so make mimi-mls wire decode via the Read path; (2) add a truncated-input regression test in mimi-mls; (3) consider reporting upstream to tls_codec (needs Mark's OK).
notes:
Upstream check 2026-10-17: FIXED UPSTREAM, UNRELEASED. RustCrypto/formats PR #2414 'tls_codec: return an error instead of panicking on truncated VLBytes' merged 2026-10-13 (commit 13a0390), https://github.com/RustCrypto/formats/pull/2414 — removes the debug_assert from VLBytes and VLByteVec tls_deserialize_bytes; covers our case exactly. crates.io latest is still 0.5.0 (2026-07-13). Related open PR #2461 (DeserializeBytes to enforce the mls-feature vector length limit). Action: nothing to file; keep the Read-path-only rule until a release with #2414; then re-evaluate.
CHECKPOINT 2026-10-18 (night). The audit found a CONFIRMED debug-build DoS: OpenMLS framing/safe_aad.rs:195 parses authenticated_data with the tls_codec bytes path after signature verification whenever the GroupContext has safe_aad (always, in mimid), so any member or external sender crashes a debug build of the agent or hub with a truncated SafeAAD (release returns MalformedSafeAad). Fix implemented in worktree .claude/worktrees/agent-a9281ff2db88457ad, uncommitted, all six gates green (1011 passed): wire.rs check_safe_aad (Read path, strict canonical decode) runs in Member::process and Observer validate before process_message. New tests/truncated_input.rs: 5 tests, inputs hand-encoded, plus mls-rs-signed SafeAAD cases that panicked before the fix. No existing tests edited. NOT landed: needs Mark's OK. FOR MARK: behaviour change: a current-epoch Commit with bad SafeAAD is now refused before authentication, so the member is NOT marked out of sync (decision .4.60 covers authenticated Commits). The mimid hub refuses such Commits too, but a non-mimid hub that accepts one would leave this member silently behind; documented in mimi-mls Limitations. Options: accept; or mark out of sync whenever a signed, current-epoch Commit fails the pre-check (that needs signature verification first, which is how we got here). The old post-OpenMLS trailing-bytes checks remain as unreachable backstops; deleting them is optional cleanup.
2026-10-18 Mark chose A: accept that a current-epoch Commit with malformed SafeAAD is refused before authentication and not marked out of sync (exception to .4.60), documented in mimi-mls Limitations.
Disclosed to Mark 2026-10-18: option A also covers trailing bytes after SafeAAD on a current-epoch Commit; .4.60 listed TrailingAad on a Commit as marking out of sync, and the pre-check now refuses it before authentication, so it no longer marks. The post-OpenMLS trailing checks (member.rs apply_processed, observer.rs ~601) are unreachable: OpenMLS parses SafeAAD exactly when safe_aad_required, which is exactly when the pre-check runs.
DECIDED 2026-10-18 (Mark), supersedes the earlier A: the pre-check refuses only a malformed/truncated SafeAAD (the crash case; not marked out of sync, Limitation). Trailing bytes after a valid SafeAAD pass to OpenMLS, and the existing post-verification TrailingAad checks (kept, not deleted) still mark a current-epoch Commit out of sync per .4.60.
close_reason: Landed 22d0459 (2026-10-18): Read-path SafeAAD pre-check refuses malformed SafeAAD only; trailing bytes still refused after verification and mark out of sync (.4.60); regression test member_marks_commit_with_trailing_aad_out_of_sync. tls_codec fix (RustCrypto/formats #2414) merged, unreleased as of 2026-10-18.
